correctness.rationale: Stationary exchangeability plus draw-one and independent post-draw losses gives m_k=q^k[(1−k/n)m_k+(k/n)m_{k−1}], hence the stated product. Boolean-lattice inclusion-exclusion gives the entire cardinality law and rho=m_n. For p=c/n, lambda_n=−n log(1−c/n)=c+c²/(2n)+O(n−2), smooth endpoint Euler–Maclaurin gives the stated A(c) factor and rate I(c). Monotone shared-draw/deletion coupling gives ||P_x^t−pi||TV ≤nq^t; lower union bound and upper block-hitting argument sandwich E T between constants times inverse rho up to polynomial n², proving only the exponent. Independent exact rational stationary-cardinality solutions checked n=1..6 at three loss rates, 18 cases, and independently evaluated A(c)e^(−nI(c)) ratios for c=.5,1,2 at n=50,200. No sharp mean prefactor asserted.
